name: detcoef
expr: d_default = detcoef(c, l); d1 = detcoef(c, l, 1); d2 = detcoef(c, l, 2); d3 = detcoef(c, l, 3); cellD = detcoef(c, l, [1 2], 'cells'); D1 = cellD{1}; D2 = cellD{2};
comment: Sig: D = detcoef(C, L[, level[, 'cells']]). Default level = numel(L) - 2 (deepest). Bug fix 2026-05-08: was throwing on 2-arg form (and previously the auditor said default = 1, but probe shows max-level). Added 'cells' form for vector levels.
